edges.reason: mint forwards execution to mintTo passing msg.sender as recipient.
mint passes msg.sender as the recipient argument.
redeem forwards execution to redeemTo passing msg.sender as recipient.
swap forwards execution to swapTo passing msg.sender as recipient.
mintTo checks the factory pause lock via onlyOwnerIfPaused.
redeemTo checks the factory pause lock via onlyOwnerIfPaused.
swapTo checks the factory pause lock via onlyOwnerIfPaused.
flashLoan checks the factory pause lock before delegating.
onlyOwnerIfPaused reads vaultFactory.isLocked to decide whether the vault is paused.
onlyOwnerIfPaused compares the caller address against the owner.
mintTo calls receiveNFTs to pull the NFTs into the vault.
mintTo mints vault shares to the recipient.
mintTo charges and distributes the mint fee.
mintTo reads mintFee to compute the total fee.
redeemTo burns the caller shares before computing fees.
redeemTo charges and distributes the redemption fees.
redeemTo calls withdrawNFTsTo to send tokens out.
redeemTo reads targetRedeemFee when computing the redemption fee.
redeemTo reads randomRedeemFee when computing the redemption fee.
totalFee computed with (amount - specificIds.length) is arithmetically sensitive to caller supplied lengths.
swapTo calls receiveNFTs to pull the NFTs into the vault.
swapTo charges and distributes the combined fees.
swapTo calls withdrawNFTsTo to send tokens out.
swapTo reads mintFee when computing the combined fee.
withdrawNFTsTo calls getRandomTokenIdFromVault for random selections.
withdrawNFTsTo invokes afterRedeemHook after withdrawals.
withdrawNFTsTo performs an external ERC1155 safeTransferFrom for 1155 vaults.
withdrawNFTsTo calls transferERC721 for 721 vaults.
receiveNFTs validates deposits using allValidNFTs.
receiveNFTs performs an external ERC1155 safeBatchTransferFrom for 1155 vaults.
receiveNFTs calls transferFromERC721 for 721 vaults.
receiveNFTs adds deposited token ids to the holdings set.
receiveNFTs accumulates quantity1155[tokenId] += amount, a value the caller controls.
receiveNFTs pulls NFTs from msg.sender as the source of the transfer.
_chargeAndDistributeFees burns fee shares from the caller.
_chargeAndDistributeFees mints fee shares to the distributor.
_chargeAndDistributeFees triggers the external distribute call on the distributor.
_chargeAndDistributeFees burns shares from msg.sender.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault mixes block.timestamp into the randomness source.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault selects from the holdings set.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault reads and increments randNonce.
transferERC721 executes a low-level call on the asset contract.
transferFromERC721 executes low-level staticcall and call on the asset contract.
setVaultFeatures is restricted by onlyPrivileged.
setFees is restricted by onlyPrivileged.
deployEligibilityStorage is restricted by onlyPrivileged.
setManager is restricted by onlyPrivileged.
onlyPrivileged reads the manager state variable to decide the authorization path.
onlyPrivileged compares msg.sender against owner or manager.
allValidNFTs reads the eligibilityStorage module address.
afterRedeemHook reads eligibilityStorage and calls its hook.
__NFTXVault_init writes the asset address.
__NFTXVault_init sets vaultFactory from msg.sender and reads numVaults.
__NFTXVault_init uses msg.sender as the factory address and vault id source.
__NFTXVault_init calls setVaultFeatures with default flags.
__NFTXVault_init calls setFees with default fee values.
flashLoan mints tokens then invokes receiver.onFlashLoan, allowing external re-entry.
safeBatchTransferFrom invokes the ERC1155 receiver hook, enabling reentrant calls into vault entry points.
safeTransferFrom invokes receiver callbacks that can re-enter minting logic.
low-level call into an arbitrary asset contract can re-enter the vault mid-deposit.
low-level call into an arbitrary asset contract can re-enter withdrawal logic.
external distribute call into the fee distributor can re-enter the vault.
